## Proposal moves

- [ ] If this PR lands, rejects, defers, or supersedes a proposal, the proposal
  file has been moved to its terminal directory
  (`docs/proposals/done/`, `docs/proposals/rejected/`, or
  `docs/proposals/deferred/`) in the same commit. Superseded proposals carry a
  `## Successor` header as informational metadata. See
  [CONTRIBUTING.md — Proposals](CONTRIBUTING.md#proposals).
